description: Ansatz synthetic physics benchmark. Per-frame truth (centroids, timestamps) is in each case's truth_file.
camera: Static camera, orthographic projection onto the motion plane (no perspective, no lens distortion, no camera shake). Scale is uniform: metres_per_pixel.

cases.description: Orange ball released from rest and dropped 2 m onto a floor; metre stick standing upright beside the path.
cases.camera: Static camera, orthographic projection onto the motion plane (no perspective, no lens distortion, no camera shake). Scale is uniform: metres_per_pixel.
cases.time_note: Frame i has video timestamp i/fps and physics timestamp i/capture_fps; for slow-motion clips the physics time is slow_motion_factor times shorter than the video time. All event times in this file are PHYSICS times.

reference.note: first band (at endpoint 0) is black; bands alternate every length/10

expected_numeric.note: Object released from rest at release_time_s; after impact it rests on the floor (soft landing), so the free-fall fit window is release_time_s..impact_time_s.
